test_title: PYST 11: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The pencil has a tip made of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is '**lead**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**lead**" refers to the material used in the pencil tip, which is actually a mixture of graphite and clay.
 
• Historically, the core of the pencil was mistakenly thought to be made of lead, but it has always been made of graphite.
 
• The other options: "**led**," "**lewd**," and "**steal**" do not fit the context appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The pencil has a tip made of lead__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Led**: is the past tense of lead, meaning to guide or direct.
 
• **Lewd**: means crude and offensive in a sexual way.
 
• **Steal**: means to take something without permission.
